Some of us were asked to take part in this and politely declined due to the original crew splitting a year or two before, the trust was broken. Few of my crew decided to join another (script kiddies compared and got caught) - The rest of us got out and got normal jobs and enjoyed making memories with our families. So that meant, they had to teach the new crew and in return sacrificed their security which equalled getting caught due to stupidity.

At this time there was a couple of groups of us in the uk. One name consistently gets mentioned in these videos and anytime i hear it I just laugh because he was such a loser in the scene back then and is the sole reason some of the best got caught. Hint: London area

One thing we were all taught is - DON'T CONTINUE AFTER 16 as the jail sentence would be far greater. When the day came, most of those if not all who got caught pleaded the mental health card and won their case / extradition. 

Back then we realised 2FA made accounts alot less secure which was pretty ironic given its purpose. Truthfully, the best method is hand written or remembered in your head only. Do not rely on a computer or anything digital, please. I've learnt that absolutely nothing is out of reach when online. 

I was a ghost online from 2013 - 2021, Removed from every database that was ever sold. To this day, I struggle with my own identity which honestly frustrates me as I was full of life before getting involved.
